criteria.statement: Execution begins at the exact authorized commit and tree.
The Stage 1 checkpoint and all 40 predecessor criteria validate.
Frozen Part 1 and protected Part 1 and Stage 1 evidence remain unchanged.
Repository and branch inventory has no unexplained overlap.
Scope and foreign-project scans pass.
All 44 criteria exist once, ordered, mapped, and fail closed.
Stage evidence schema, receipt, and validator reject malformed or premature success.
All five semantic authority seams have explicit versioned resolutions.
Toolchain and dependencies are authorized, reproducible, and non-lossy.
JSON, JSONL, and Parquet paths are exercised without skips.
The profile has immutable identity, settings and fixture digests, and a closed capability matrix.
Synthetic provenance is explicit and not represented as managed DMS output.
Raw manifests validate identity, safe paths, bytes, rows, order, lineage, and boundaries.
Missing, changed, extra, duplicate, conflicting, mixed, gap, and overlap objects fail stably.
Unknown profiles, versions, fields, and lossy scalars fail closed.
Unavailable capabilities are never synthesized or inferred.
Contract and schema identity validate before event identity.
Supported snapshot and insert records normalize into valid envelopes.
Update and delete require authentic complete images and keys.
Canonical keys, Unicode, decimal, timestamp, null, binary, and nested values are lossless.
PostgreSQL LSN comparison is numeric and fail closed.
CDC positions satisfy S less than position at most object end.
Source position and source sequences determine order, not time or arrival.
Event identity matches accepted domain-separated material.
Payload digest matches accepted semantic payload material.
Equivalent serialization, format, and arrival permutation produce identical output.
Same event identity and payload is duplicate-safe.
Same event identity with different payload is a terminal conflict.
Every rejected record produces one immutable stable-code quarantine record.
Accepted and quarantined outputs are mutually exclusive per raw record.
Unsafe records cannot reach canonical output.
Minimal counterexamples produce exact expected diagnostics.
Property tests cover canonical values, collisions, identity, and arrival permutations.
Differential comparison agrees with accepted Stage 1 semantic history.
Boundary, order, replay, conflict, delete, schema, generation, and evidence invariants pass.
CLI publication is atomic and cannot seal partial success.
Two clean runs produce byte-identical outputs and semantic evidence.
Static, typing, full, coverage, focused, failure, and predecessor checks pass.
Evidence is identity-bound, deterministic, safe, and non-recursive.
Claims remain at the narrow local adapter ceiling with managed limitations.
Every required check passes on the exact reviewed pull-request head.
Expected-head policy merge succeeds and main has the reviewed tree.
Post-merge CI, detached validation, integrity, preservation, and cleanup pass.
External continuation checkpoint records the exact Stage 3 entry contract.
